augmentation: paired horizontal flip at p=0.5, canonical normal x sign inverted
domain_sampling: equal images from Hypersim and Arb in every microbatch
mask_reduction: mean over valid pixels within image, then mean over images
selection: final fixed-budget checkpoint; no test-set selection; pilot used only for numerical preflight

label_sources.Arb: Cycles BSDF normal pass; normalTexture classification may be unknown

note: Pilot single-seed outcomes do not establish ranking or replace the three-seed formal comparison. Fixed-budget outcomes do not establish convergence.
